creator: nocode.joshua
title: Three personal Claude agents from a 5-year developer: voice 'Bring to Life' agent that prototypes ideas from a walk, a Capture agent that files tasks/notes into ~50 Notion databases, and a Daily Review agent with calendar/email/task access
claims: Bring to Life agent: voice an idea on a walk, it returns a prototype or rough design sketch plus research plan by the time you are back at the desk
Capture agent organizes tasks, projects, notes, videos across 'another 50 databases' in Notion
Daily Review agent evaluates the day (what went well, what to improve, insights, plan for tomorrow) using calendar, emails, tasks, via voice
how_to_steps: Create a 'Bring to Life' agent whose goal is to output prototype/design/research plan from a voice idea
Create a Capture agent with Notion access to store info in the right databases
Create a Daily Review agent with calendar/email/task access and run it by voice each evening
